note: Blind evaluation of the tenka-desk engine on two independently generated fictional datasets. Engine labels were written by scripts/blind-score.ts before the truth was read; the truth hashes were checked against blind/<gen>/SEALED.sha256 first. Lines the truth marks ambiguous are excluded from precision/recall and reported per pattern.

runs.default: engine-labels.csv: the app with default settings: no 改定日 typed for the agreements file (the app may infer it from the data; see workspace.ts chooseRevision). Before the fix on branch tenka-desk-revision-fix the app did not infer it; those figures are in commit 20004cd.
runs.revdate: engine-labels.revdate.csv: the same, after typing the 改定日 of the agreements file on the import screen (from demo_settings.json previousRevisionDate / the README).
runs.followup: engine-followup(.tag).csv: the 反映チェック of each new price master in next/ against the sales export there, scored against truth/followup_lines.csv when the sealed truth has it.

engine.overcharge (status): overcharge (kept: the engine never counts billing above the expected price as a leak)
